rows.grounds: bahuvrīhi or karmadhāraya compound describing the figure

items.question: What bodily form and visual characteristics define the appearance of the described figure?
premises: The figure resembles smoke in appearance.
items.inference: These attributes collectively specify the distinctive iconographic appearance of the figure.
uncertainties: The exact referent among the previously named sages is not explicit within this verse alone.
items.plain_english: He is two-armed, of great vigor, copper-eyed, and resembling smoke.
